title: Grammys 2027: the nominations in all the major categories
description:
With numerous nods for Raye, Rosalía, Olivia Rodrigo, Olivia Dean and others, check out the nominated artists for the 2027 Grammy awards for album of the year and more

Olivia Dean – Man I Need
Ella Langley – Choosin’ Texas
Bruno Mars – I Just Might
Raye – Where is My Husband!
Olivia Rodrigo – The Cure
Rosalía featuring Björk & Yves Tumor – Berghain
Taylor Swift – The Fate of Ophelia
Tame Impala & Jennie – Dracula
